senses.gloss:
स्फोट m. (-टः)
 1. A boil, a tumour.
 2. Breaking, bursting.
 3. Revealing,
disclosure, (as in नर्मस्फोट.)
 4. The idea which bursts out or flashes
on the mind when a sound is uttered.
 f. (-टा) The hood of the
snake.
 E. स्फुट् to break or open, aff. घञ् ।
स्फोटा f. (-टा) The expanded hood of a snake.

स्फोटक m. (-कः) A boil, a tumour.
 f. (-टिका) A sort of bird.
 E. स्फुट् to burst, ण्वुल् aff.

स्फोटन n. (-नं)
 1. Tearing, rending.
 2. The act of rending suddenly,
splitting, cracking.
 3. Fidgetting with the hand, cracking the
finger-joints, snapping the fingers, &c.
 4. Winnowing grain.
 5.
The separation of the letters of a double consonant.
 m. (-नः)
Separated utterance of a close combination of consonants.
 f. (-नी)
Adj. Disclosing, making clear.
 f. (-नी) A gimlet, an auger. E.
स्फुट् to open, (as a flower, &c.) causal form, aff. ल्युट् ।
स्फोटायन m. (-नः) A Muni so named.

स्फोटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Torn, rent.
 2. Made to open or burst.
 E. स्फुट्
to break, causal v., क्त aff.
